name: Private Sector Banks
angle: Lender report (use lender metrics everywhere). Forces: the deposit war and CASA erosion; NIM compression through the 2025-26 RBI rate-cut cycle; unsecured retail / credit-card / MFI stress and credit costs; loan-to-deposit ratio after the HDFC-HDFC Bank merger; large vs mid-size vs small private banks; digital and fee income; governance episodes (e.g. IndusInd derivatives accounting 2025). KPI masterclass on NIM, CASA, cost of funds, credit cost, GNPA/NNPA/PCR, RoA tree, CET1, LDR.

name: Real Estate Developers
angle: Pre-sales vs revenue recognition (POCM/completed-contract accounting under Ind AS 115), collections, launches, land banks and JDAs, the 2021-26 residential upcycle and luxury shift, regional markets (MMR, NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad), RERA, net debt and cash flows, annuity/commercial office and REITs, inventory overhang. KPIs: pre-sales, collections, realisation per sq ft, launches, embedded EBITDA margin, net debt/equity.

name: IT Services
angle: Constant-currency growth and deal TCV, GenAI-driven deflation in run/maintain work, US clients' discretionary spend, the 2025-26 US H-1B fee and visa/tariff politics, GCCs (global capability centres) as competitor and customer, margins (utilisation, pyramid, subcontracting, wage hikes, rupee), attrition and headcount, tier-1 vs mid-tier. KPIs: cc growth, TCV and book-to-bill, EBIT margin bridge, revenue per employee, utilisation, top-client concentration, DSO, FCF conversion.

name: Cement
angle: Consolidation (UltraTech-India Cements/Kesoram, Adani-Ambuja-ACC-Sanghi-Penna-Orient), capacity race and utilisation, regional pricing (South/North/East/Central/West), realisation per tonne, EBITDA per tonne, fuel (petcoke/coal) and freight costs, green power, limestone and mining royalties, demand from housing and infrastructure. KPIs: capacity MTPA, utilisation, volume growth, realisation/t, cost/t, EBITDA/t, capex per tonne, net debt/EBITDA.

name: Industrial Products
angle: A diverse sub-sector: first map the members into 3-5 archetypes (e.g. pipes, bearings, valves, castings, tools, wires, other engineered products) and build the report around those archetypes, their end-markets (auto, infra, oil & gas, water, exports) and the capex cycle. Cover China+1 exports, raw-material pass-through (steel, copper, PVC), working capital, order books where relevant.

name: Power Generation
angle: Thermal PLF and coal supply, the renewable build-out (solar, wind, hybrid, round-the-clock), storage (BESS, pumped hydro), merchant power prices on IEX, PPAs and regulated ROE returns, peak demand records, transmission bottlenecks, state discom dues (LPS rules), nuclear and hydro, capex and leverage. KPIs: installed and under-construction GW, PLF/CUF, regulated equity, tariff, merchant share, cost per MW, net debt/EBITDA.

name: Iron & Steel
angle: Steel spreads (HRC price minus iron ore and coking coal per tonne), Chinese exports and India's safeguard duty, capacity expansion toward 300 MTPA, captive mines and the iron-ore auction regime, coking-coal import dependence, demand from infra/auto/construction, integrated vs secondary/DRI producers, decarbonisation and CBAM. KPIs: capacity, utilisation, sales volume, realisation/t, EBITDA/t, cost/t, net debt/EBITDA, capex per tonne.

name: Heavy Electrical Equipment
angle: The transmission and grid capex supercycle (CEA plans, HVDC, green-energy corridors), transformer and switchgear shortages and pricing, thermal power's comeback (BHEL orders), MNC listed subsidiaries (Siemens, ABB, Hitachi Energy, GE Vernova T&D) vs domestic makers, exports, order books and execution, working capital. KPIs: order inflow, order book / revenue cover, book-to-bill, execution rate, EBITDA margin, working-capital days, capacity (MVA).

name: Other Electrical Equipment
angle: First map the members into archetypes (e.g. solar modules/cells, wind turbines, motors, batteries, EV/charging, meters, other electricals) and build the report around them: PLI and ALMM rules for solar, domestic content, China pricing, the renewable demand pipeline, order books, capacity ramps and margins. Use the members list to decide the archetypes.

name: Aerospace & Defence
angle: Indigenisation (positive indigenisation lists, DAP 2020, Make in India), the defence capital budget, order books and execution (HAL, BEL, BDL, shipyards, private players), Operation Sindoor (May 2025) and emergency procurement, exports growth, aerospace supply chain (Boeing/Airbus offsets, engines), PSU vs private margins and working capital. KPIs: order book, book-to-bill, execution, EBITDA margin, advances and working capital, export share, R&D intensity.
